candidate_oracle.definition: Every fixed unobserved node with GT remains in the oracle denominator, including E-only fallback. GT chooses the best valid candidate independently at those nodes; all other nodes retain E. The resulting interpolated full vIoU is an offline readout, not a method and not the exact global trajectory upper bound.

r.micro_Spearman_definition: Correlation of concatenated within-state centered standardized average ranks; equivalent to candidate-count weighted within-state Spearman
r.macro_definition: Each query averages its identifiable node/path Spearman; pair accuracy pools its same-state non-GT-tie pairs; then queries receive equal weight
r.missing_definition: E-only/constant states remain in coverage counts and oracle denominators; unidentified ranking metrics are None, not a fabricated 0.5
